name: Frame & Render Performance Profiler
summary: Profile native and post-processed Forge scenes with separate warm-up/measurement windows, CPU stages, GPU timers when supported, shader compile cost, draw/triangle/texture/stall counters, percentiles, spikes, overhead, and digest-bound worst-state screenshots.
actions: inspect P50 P95 and worst frames
notes: GPU timings fail typed when the timer-query extension is unavailable. Overdraw is an explicit pressure proxy until the renderer gains a pixel-exact analysis pass.
